info.name: Tiered Rate Limiter — Grading Collection
info.description: Weighted test suite for scoring the Rate Limiter take-home assignment. Each test is tagged [W<weight>][CATEGORY]. Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner, or folder by folder), then read "Z. FINAL SCORE SUMMARY" at the bottom of the test results for the weighted total and per-category breakdown — no external tooling needed. IMPORTANT: to grade a NEW candidate, re-import this collection file fresh (or manually reset the collection's variables in the Variables tab) so scores do not carry over from a previous run.
